tasks.title: Select all students
tasks.prompt: Given a table `students` with columns `id` (integer), `name` (text), `age` (integer), write a SQL query to retrieve all columns for all students.

setup: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER, name TEXT, age INTEGER);

tasks.title: Select names and ages
tasks.prompt: Given a table `employees` with columns `id` (integer), `name` (text), `salary` (real), write a SQL query to retrieve the name and salary of each employee.

setup: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name TEXT, salary REAL);

tasks.title: Select students older than 20
tasks.prompt: Given a table `students` with columns `id` (integer), `name` (text), `age` (integer), write a SQL query to retrieve the names of students older than 20.

setup: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER, name TEXT, age INTEGER);

tasks.reference: SELECT name FROM students WHERE age > 20;

tasks.title: Order students by age descending
tasks.prompt: Given a table `students` with columns `id` (integer), `name` (text), `age` (integer), write a SQL query to retrieve all columns ordered by age descending.

setup: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER, name TEXT, age INTEGER);

tasks.reference: SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY age DESC;

tasks.title: Count students per grade
tasks.prompt: Given a table `students` with columns `id` (integer), `name` (text), `grade` (integer), write a SQL query to retrieve each grade and the number of students in that grade.

setup: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER, name TEXT, grade INTEGER);

tasks.reference: SELECT grade, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY grade;

tasks.title: Join students and courses
tasks.prompt: Given two tables: `students` (id INTEGER, name TEXT) and `enrollments` (student_id INTEGER, course TEXT). Write a SQL query to retrieve the student name and course for each enrollment.

setup: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE enrollments (student_id INTEGER, course TEXT);

tasks.reference: SELECT students.name, enrollments.course FROM students JOIN enrollments ON students.id = enrollments.student_id;
